timeline.summary: On 21 April 2026 Valor Estate disclosed postal-ballot results: all five resolutions passed, including Sundaram Rajagopal as Independent Director, three related-party transactions and Arshad Balwa's appointment, with 19.06% of votes cast against the Shiv Infra Riverwalk RPT.

On 1 May 2026 Valor Estate said the Bombay High Court on 30 April 2026 dismissed the Salt Department's First Appeal No. 1430 of 2019, upholding its wholly owned subsidiary Miraland Developers' title to about 205 acres at Bhayandar, Thane.
On 29 May 2026, Valor Estate reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,593 Cr and a return to profit of ₹27 Cr, alongside ₹1,136 Cr in debt reduction.
